query: Humanize this AI-generated draft for our email nurture sequence: 'In today's fast-paced digital landscape, our platform empowers teams to unlock seamless collaboration—it's a game-changing paradigm shift that leverages cutting-edge technology to elevate your workflow, delivering a truly transformative experience.'
expected_behavior: Runs Phase 1 Diagnosis and names at least five banned phrases or AI-isms in the draft (for example fast-paced digital landscape, empowers, unlock, seamless, game-changing paradigm shift, leverages, elevate, transformative experience)
Removes the em dash from the draft, replacing it with a period, comma, or a restructured sentence rather than carrying it into the rewrite
Output contains zero banned Kill List phrases
Output contains zero em dashes or en dashes
Rewrites with varied sentence rhythm, including at least one short sentence under six words, rather than one long compound sentence
